notes.title: AFTER THE GAME, THE COMIC VERSION
notes.notes:
Hello Aurionics and [b]Happy New Year 2018[/b].

The Kiro’o team sends you its best wishes this new year and greatly thanks you for choosing to participate in the Aurionic adventure with us.

[quote] ’’As you already know Aurion is neither a story of prophecy, it’s not good against evil… etc.
 This is a story about the inner quest burried in every human being: What is the purpose of mankind?’’ [/quote]
 
The first African-fantasy finally has it’s own comic version.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9303013/479d356beb4df5a4d89df64a2214040e2c8cc320.jpg[/img]

The game was released in 2016 and your numerous reviews agreed on the quality of the scenario and the game even attracted Hollywood’s attention.

Rediscover and share with your friend a deep story about the inner quest of every human being and their intense battles.


The first 4 chapters are available on:  

- [url=https://www.behance.net/gallery/60503953/Aurion-Legacy-of-the-Kori-odan] BEHANCE	[/url]

Do not hesitate to share at it.

Enjoy reading and see you soon. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch for quick start in Aurion !!
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Aurionics,
The team has worked to make the beginning in the game faster.
For those who don't like reading ːsteammockingː, you can now directly go to the wedding when the game starts, and so avoid the long griot talk about the story of Zama.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9303013/7e98844223a519946ce3b560b062f6623591b508.jpg[/img]

Just go to the palace to the left after the garden.

About the loading problem, when you will go out of Figuil, the game loading will be faster since the mapping is more optimised. 

Thanks for your feedbacks and the passion you share with us.

notes.title: Aurionic patch 1.2.1 (Fighting shorter & offline mode ok)
notes.notes:
Some have asked, Kiro'o Games made changes. Well of course we still had some sissy (ːAurion_Happyː) who have not completed their aurionic pilgrimage and are beaten by some Trakas!? We will allow you to better assimilate your aurions in order to become true warriors.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9303013/ea6c6034014c7b44635101199699fd8e24e27eb7.jpg[/img]

Remember to follow the teachings of Ju'u StC@mus Souleyris, he will always guide you in your quest.
So in this patch, we have good things for you:
[list]
[*] Resolving a feature that prevents the execution of the game in offline mode
[*] Rebalancing warriors data to avoid long fights 
[*] Changes in the consumption of Enzo magic points
[*] Fixed some bugs on game
[/list]

Ancient aurionics, reincarnate the king of Zama and with your queen, redefine your legacy and rediscover what king you are for your city, show the way to newcommers so everyone focuses on his pilgrimage.

PS: We awaiting for your feedback!

notes.title: BIG NEWS : THE ENGLISH TRANSLATION PATCH IS READY !!
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Aurionics,
Finally after 13 days of your gaming patience, we are delighted to tell you that [b]the final english patch is now included into the game[/b]. 

[img]http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/kiroo_astral_english_patch.jpg[/img]

This is the end of the “translation gate” era for our community and we are very happy that our english fan base will now be able to enjoy our game as much as our French community.

Also as you may have noticed, the previous patches made the game very stable for a very good aurionic experience. A warm thanks again to our first aurionics for their feedbacks.

We also share with you this wall of good quotes on some major websites and some firsts good reviews.
 
[img]http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/Aurionic_golden_quotes.jpg[/img]

Links for the press features :
[list]
[*] [url=http://kotaku.com/from-the-heart-of-africa-an-action-video-game-with-sou-1771648525]KOTAKU[/url] 
[*] [url=http://www.polygon.com/2016/4/22/11475512/aurion-gameplay-video ]POLYGON[/url] 
[*] [url=https://www.universalgamingreviews.com/aurion-legacy-of-the-kori-odan-overview-and-review/ ]UNIVERSAL GAMING[/url] 
[/list]

We are now waiting your feedbacks (and a lot of thumbs up in steam review section!) about your final gaming experience in AurionLKO, and we hope you will share the word in your gaming networks so that our Aurionic community grows.

notes.title: Release Patch 1.02 (04-21-2016)
notes.notes:
Hello dear aurionics,
Tonight we publish the 1.02 patch which solve some bugs that have been raised by the community since the last patch released.

[img]http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/kiroo_astral_v102.jpg[/img]

The list is as follows:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevents the use of some items in the inventory menu
[*] Fix teleportation bug into the ocean after some fights in the world map
[*] Updated visual areas: Shakai Yai Royal Tent Camp in Bojaa
[*] Visual enhancements of some magic effects
[*] Visual enhancements of Enzo movements
[*] Minor adjustments to some enemies setting
[*] Removing a sound effect of a Ngarba magic that caused some bugs
[*] Fix a little bug when pressing the F5 hotkey to switch between full screen and window mode and vice versa caused on some PC
[/list]

Please check that this release resolve any bugs that some of you had and leave us your feedback.

Note: Yeah we aware many of you are awaiting english translation. We have already received a good part of texts. They are about to be integrated into the game. We are doing our best to quickly end this chapter.

notes.title: The Aurionic Patch 1.01 (19-04-2016)
notes.notes:
Hello dear Aurionics,
While waititing the sacred and legendary English patch for the anglo-saxons community, we  release the patch 1.01 which should solve a good deal of the bugs reported in our forum.
The "scientist" of Kiro'o Games took all the day and night to make this one after your really cool and precise feedback on crash situation.

[img]http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/kiroo_astral_v101.jpg[/img]

The following improvements have been performed:
[list]
[*] Optimize effects of the resurrection that made the game crash

[*] Decrease lags due to the loading of battle sounds

[*] Blocking the aurionic charge  (manual AP charge) when we're not in good visual condition

[*] Fixed teleportation after a fight at "Mansa Kono" [b](dedicaced to Sams94fr)[/b]

[*] Fix bug when trying to use Leader state against Ngarba at the entrance of  Kajuta Roho

[*] Fixed the bug that Enzo slide when we want to move while blocking

[*] Optimization of Dramane's assets that cause memory overload (including NTU Bridge and Bawangaa war)

[*] General optimization of stability of memory tests

[/list]


Update 19-04-2016 @ 3.03PM
[list]
[*] Fix crash when stating fighting against Malik

[*] Fix a bug after combat against Sidune when selected language is French

[*] Fix Souleyris' sword data which completely restore Enzo when hitting an ennemy

[/list]

notes.title: Aurionic Patch 1.00 (17-04-2016)
notes.notes:
Hello dear Aurionics, 
Thanks to your feedbacks these first days, we managed to make some fixes on the game. 
The "anti translation gate" is still on progress and we hope a big patch about this matter next week. 
But it seems after those 1st hours the game is better translated on its current state. That's the feedback of some players at least. 

[img]http://aurionthegame.com/img/steam/kiroo_astral_v100.jpg[/img]

Anyway, we keep forwarding your passion and the pressure to our partner. 
[list]
[*] Resetting the matching window keyboard <->Pad 
[*] Modify Sidune’s AI so he can now launch his Ultimate Legacy 
[*] Modify the Enzo face during Aurionic fusion. 
[*] Players can now use F5 to quit fullscreen Mode 
[*] Title Menu : debug of the glitches with the party menu. 
[*] “Achievement” menu has been renamed as “Steam”, since it will also contain the DLC list. 
[*] Adding the “return” word in the loading save windows 
[*] Fix the success “Launch 30 Ultimate Legacy”. 
[*] Debug of the camera glitch which often suddenly get back on Enzo. 
[*] Insertion of some text full translated (Items, Aurionites, and the 
beginning of Zama, just before you talk with the old griot) 
[*] Light remapping of the Elorine combat zone. 
[*] Updated the pictures on the Aurionic fusion tutorial. 
[/list]
We hope to see you continue playing and we are curious to get your feedbacks, especially the feedback of the 1st one who will finish the game. The end is... well you will see. But as old RPG gamers, we think we have created something there. 

Update 10 a.m : We fixed the Koross boss fight and the Nabi Dialog fault due to some missing fonts in the English version of the game. For the final mistakes about the text (text out of some bubbles, etc.) we are waiting for the final English patch to correct it.


Update 8 p.m : we fixed the micro stuttering from the morning patch (if you continue to have ones, just turn off post processing in option it helps). Also we fixed a shop bug with the keyboard. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Patch Aurionique 1.00 (17-04-2016)
notes.notes:
Bonjour les Aurioniques,
Voici quelques modifications que nous avons apporté au jeu durant vos premiers retours depuis le 14 :
[list]
[*] Réinitialisation de la fenêtre de correspondance de touche clavier <-> manette
[*] Modifier IA de Sidune pour qu'il puisse faire ses Héritages Ultimes
[*] Modification du visage d’Enzo en fusion aurionique
[*] Ajout de F5 permettant de quitter le mode Plein écran 
[*] Menu titre : debug du conflit d’affichage avec le menu de partie.
[*] Menu succès a été renommé en Steam vu qu’il contient aussi les DLC.
[*] Surcharge du texte "retour" en mode clavier dans la page de chargement de partie
[*] Fix succès "Lancer 30 Héritages ultimes"
[*] Fix sur la caméra qui se déplaçait brusquement sur Enzo.
[*] Intégration de quelques textes traduits OK (objets, aurionites, et début de Zama)
[*] Léger remapping de la zone de combat de Elorine 
[*] Update des images du tutoriel sur la fusion Aurionique.
[/list]
On espère vous voir continuer de jouer. La fin du jeu sera... on vous laisse découvrir, mais vous devriez vraiment apprécier. 
Nous sommes curieux d'avoir l'avis du premier qui finira le jeu. En tant que vieux joueurs de rpg on pense avoir créé quelque chose qui va vous plaire.

MAJ 11h du 17-04-2016 : Nous avons réglé le bug de Nabi et certains problèmes apparus après le patch d'hier.

MAJ 21h du 17-04-2016 : On a réglé le problème de mini lag de la MAJ du matin, ainsi que le bug des boutiques en clavier. Merci de vos retours à tous et de votre patience. Si vous avez encore des micro-lags essayez de désactiver le "post-traitement" dans les options.

notes.title: Cameroonian Devs Release Aurion: Legacy Of The Kori-Odan
notes.notes:
Cameroonian studio Kiro’o Games have released Aurion: Legacy of the Kori-Odan [official site], a side-scrolling action-RPG inspired by African myths and culture. It’s also about duffing folks up with flashy combos, zipping all over the place and giving them good hard whacks – it’s looking strong on the action side of action-RPG, a bit of a beat ‘em up in the ‘Tales Of‘ style.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: "What is the purpose of Mankind?" New Trailer & Release Date !!!!
notes.notes:
Hey Aurionics,

Today we are pleased to share with you this new trailer which gives the depth overview of the game Word and mostly, the date release of the game.

The main particularity of this trailer is the fact that it is doubled in one Cameroonian dialect named Bassa.

[url=https://youtu.be/TeL-sCQSn_0]Click Here to look[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/TeL-sCQSn_0]https://youtu.be/TeL-sCQSn_0[/url]
[b]A deep scenario, existential issues, personal quests...[/b]

As you can see, we plan to release on [b]April 14th[/b], so get ready !!!

In the previous videos, most of the gameplay has been unveiled, as well as a tiny part of scenario. So far Aurion was presented as a story of two young sovereigns exiled from their city because of a coup d'état. They do a quest in order to become stronger and retrieve their city. This new trailer is referred to what the game is. Aurion, over the ambitious gameplay which has been well appreciated, shows great promise about a deep scenario, we think will surprise more than one. The exile's story which has been revealed (in the demo) is just the beginning of an existential quest. This quest will be more existential, turning around personal questions which will surely retain the attention of many gamers, all with a dynamic staging.

The best still coming .Feel free to leave a comment or share this video if you enjoyed

Aurionics  yours!
